Chief_Complaint.content: 3-day history of watery diarrhea occurring approximately 5–6 times per day

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Watery diarrhea for 3 days occurring approximately 5–6 times per day
Initially had 2 episodes of vomiting which have resolved
Patient feels dehydrated, weak, with decreased appetite and limited oral intake
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: feels dehydrated, weak, ↓ appetite, limited PO intake

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Felt slightly warm on day 1 but is afebrile now
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Fever: felt “a bit warm” day 1; afebrile now

Medications.content: Oral rehydration salts such as Dioralyte to be taken as directed
Medications.source_text: Oral rehydration salts (e.g., Dioralyte) – as directed

Medications.content: Paracetamol as needed for malaise or fever

Social_and_Family_History.content: Has been off work for the past 3 days

Assessment.content: Acute viral gastroenteritis with watery diarrhea, prior vomiting, and risk of dehydration
Assessment.source_text: 1. Acute viral gastroenteritis ⟶ watery diarrhea, prior vomiting, dehydration risk

Plan_of_Care.content: Start oral rehydration salts such as Dioralyte as directed
Plan_of_Care.source_text: Oral rehydration salts (e.g., Dioralyte) – as directed

Plan_of_Care.content: Use paracetamol as needed for malaise or fever
Rest and remain off work until diarrhea-free for at least 24–48 hours
Plan_of_Care.source_text: Rest; off work until diarrhea-free ≥24–48 h

Plan_of_Care.content: Return to clinic or seek review if symptoms persist longer than one week, worsen, or if red-flag features such as fever, blood in stool, or severe pain develop
Plan_of_Care.source_text: RTC/seek review if symptoms persist >1 wk, worsen, or red-flag features (fever, blood, severe pain) emerge

Follow_up_Information.content: Advised to return to clinic or seek review if symptoms persist for more than one week, worsen, or if red-flag features such as fever, blood in stool, or severe pain occur
